info.name: Spotter Fuel Route Planner API
info.description:
Django REST API: route between two US locations, cost-optimal fuel stops (500-mile range, 10 mpg), total fuel cost and a saved Leaflet map.

Set base_url (default http://127.0.0.1:8000) and start the server (see README). Example responses are real captures from a local run on 2026-11-16. Hosts are replaced with {{base_url}}, and long geometry or stop lists are truncated where marked.

request.description: Database and station-data status. 503 if no stations are loaded.

item.name: Short route, no fuel stop (Washington, DC -> New York, NY)

request.description:
225.6 miles: the full starting tank covers the trip. Only starting fuel is burned (22.56 gal), and the rest is reported as fuel remaining.

Real response captured from a local run on 2026-11-16. Example edited only by: route.geometry.coordinates truncated from 226 to 4 points.

exec: pm.test("total = starting fuel estimate + purchased during trip", () => { const c = b.fuel_cost; pm.expect(c.total_fuel_cost).to.be.closeTo(c.starting_fuel_estimate.estimated_value_of_fuel_used + c.purchased_during_trip.cost, 0.011); });
pm.test("at most one routing API call", () => pm.expect(b.meta.map_api_calls.routing).to.be.at.most(1));
pm.test("stop costs add up to the trip cost", () => { const sum = b.fuel_stops.reduce((a, s) => a + s.cost, 0); pm.expect(sum).to.be.closeTo(b.fuel_cost.purchased_during_trip.cost, 0.001); });
pm.test("no leg longer than the vehicle range", () => pm.expect(b.fuel_usage.longest_leg_miles).to.be.at.most(b.fuel_usage.max_range_miles));
console.log("routing calls:", b.meta.map_api_calls.routing, "cache hit:", b.meta.route_cache_hit, "timings:", JSON.stringify(b.meta.timings_ms));

item.name: 4. Provider failures (start the server with a broken OSRM_BASE_URL)
item.description:
These need a server started with an unreachable routing provider and a route that is not cached, e.g.

    OSRM_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9 python manage.py runserver
        -> 503 routing_unavailable
    OSRM_BASE_URL=http://10.255.255.1 ROUTING_CONNECT_TIMEOUT=3 python manage.py runserver
        -> 504 routing_timeout

The example responses were captured from exactly those configurations (real responses, not mocked).
